description: Defines SCTP socket parameters and class interface for socket operations such as create, bind, connect, listen, and configuration options, including logging and socket options.

classes.name: sctp_socket
classes.description: Represents an SCTP socket with methods for creation, binding, connecting, listening, and configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an SCTP socket with specified parameters.

methods.name: is_open
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the socket's file descriptor.

methods.name: bindx
methods.description: Binds the socket to one or multiple addresses.

methods.name: connectx
methods.description: Connects the socket to one or multiple addresses.

methods.name: set_non_blocking
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: get_bound_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the socket is bound to.

methods.name: get_address_family
methods.description: Returns the address family of the socket.

methods.name: set_sockopts
methods.description: Sets socket options based on parameters.
